title: Name the Condition
prompt: is_ok(age, member) is needed by two different checks in the starter. Write it: True when age >= 18 AND member is truthy. Use it from both call sites — do not duplicate the logic.

tests.name: logic written once
tests.code:
assert check_ticket(19, True) is True
assert check_entry(17, True) is False
assert "age >= 18 and member" not in code.split("def is_ok")[-1] or True
assert code.count("age >= 18 and member") == 1, "the condition should live in ONE place"
tests.hint: def is_ok(age, member): return age >= 18 and member — and both wrappers call it.
